none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained convex differentiable minimization of f:E→ℝ on a real Hilbert space. The gradient is globally L-Lipschitz, L>0. A minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R, R≥0.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Each query x returns exactly ∇f(x), for every call index and oracle seed. Only gradients are supplied; function values are unavailable. The oracle has no gradient error or noise.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvexUnknownL.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, and HasGradientAt clause in spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: unknown_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The algorithm receives only E, its real Hilbert-space structure, and x0. The parameters L>0, R≥0, and ε>0 are hidden from the algorithm constructor; a convergence budget may depend on them.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvexUnknownL.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm and budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a complete real inner-product space, with no finite-dimensional restriction. A minimizer lies within distance R of the public initial point x0.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvexUnknownL.lean: Public.completeE, Public.linearE, and minimizer-distance clause in spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The output is a point in E satisfying f(output)−f(x⋆)≤ε, ε>0, for an existing global minimizer x⋆.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap bound holds almost surely under the specified output probability law. Algorithms may be randomized; deterministic success is not required.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Smooth convex minimization with an exact gradient oracle, a bounded initial distance to a minimizer, and unknown smoothness is an established standard formulation. No proved results or complexity budgets were supplied.
